ledger_sign_by_type.name: ledger_sign_by_type
ledger_sign_by_type.value:
CASE "ledger_entries"."entry_type"
        WHEN 'boundary_charge' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_centavos" > 0
        WHEN 'amortization_charge' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_centavos" > 0
        WHEN 'cost_charge' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_centavos" > 0
        WHEN 'deposit_charge' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_centavos" > 0
        WHEN 'payment' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_centavos" < 0
        WHEN 'bonus_credit' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_centavos" < 0
        ELSE true END

loan_payment_sign.name: loan_payment_sign
loan_payment_sign.value: ("loan_payments"."reverses_payment_id" IS NULL AND "loan_payments"."amount_centavos" > 0) OR ("loan_payments"."reverses_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_payments"."amount_centavos" < 0)
